monitoring_categories.default_action: Alert the responsible operator and gather diagnostic evidence.
Prioritize the incident according to business impact and notify the owner.
Check documented dependencies and use approved fallback behavior.
Compare against the established baseline and investigate likely causes.
Open a migration integrity issue and route it to the relevant owner.

automation_boundaries: Read-only diagnostics may run automatically when authorized.
Approved reversible fixes may run within explicit limits.
Production configuration changes require the applicable authorization.
Destructive operations and sensitive-data changes must not be triggered solely by an unverified alert.
Escalate when evidence is insufficient or impact may be critical.
Do not place credentials or patient information in alerts.
